Synthets Menace (cut mission)

Synthets Menace is scenario 6 of a series of six scenarios of Etherlords that were never released. The texts of the series (MT_S01 to MT_S06) are filled in only in the English edition, which also has each briefing as the text of a spoken one; in the Russian edition the same texts are empty. No map of either edition uses them.

Briefing

The briefing opens with the Latin motto si vis pacem, para bellum. The Synthets invade the lands of the Vitals once more. The Vitals cannot hold out against their attack head-on, but the Gates stand in the Synthets' way and give the Vitals the chance to strike back first.

In the game's own wiki, the full briefing from your copy of the game appears here (the Russian edition has none):

The conditions, as the English edition words them:

ConditionText
ObjectiveDestroy enemy Castle
VictoryDestroy enemy Castle
DefeatLose your Castle

What is known

Only the texts remain; no heroes, decks or program rules are tied to this map.

The series

The six scenarios: Savage Desert · Balance of Terror · First Strike · Ice Trap · Dragon Lake · Synthets Menace.
